zh.title: 美國海軍陸戰隊接收第359架暨最後一架MV-22B魚鷹傾轉旋翼機
zh.summary: 根據AeroTime報導，美國海軍陸戰隊已接收第359架暨最後一架Bell Boeing MV-22B Osprey傾轉旋翼機，正式完成該型機的交付計畫。Bell Boeing完成該架機體交付後，海軍陸戰隊的MV-22機隊計畫全數結案。
body: 根據航空新聞媒體AeroTime報導，美國海軍陸戰隊已正式接收第359架、同時也是最後一架Bell Boeing MV-22B Osprey傾轉旋翼機。此項交付代表著美國海軍陸戰隊該型傾轉旋翼機計畫的正式完成。
Bell Boeing在交付這架機號為第359架的MV-22B Osprey傾轉旋翼機後，完成全數機隊的交付流程。這項訊息由AeroTime報導發布，確認了該機型採購計畫的最終交付狀態。

en.title: US Marine Corps Receives 359th and Final Bell Boeing MV-22B Osprey
en.summary: The US Marine Corps has received its 359th and final Bell Boeing MV-22B Osprey tiltrotor aircraft, bringing the service's long-running procurement program to an official completion. According to details reported by aviation news outlet AeroTime, the final aircraft delivery marks the end of scheduled handovers for the tiltrotor platform to the Marine Corps. With this milestone delivery, manufacturer Bell Boeing has fulfilled all planned aircraft units under the established MV-22 program schedule.
body: The United States Marine Corps has received its 359th and final Bell Boeing MV-22B Osprey tiltrotor aircraft, marking the official completion of the military branch's tiltrotor program. The delivery represents the final aircraft scheduled for handover to the service under the MV-22 procurement schedule, as reported by aviation news outlet AeroTime.

The handover of the 359th aircraft by manufacturers Bell and Boeing concludes the delivery phase for the US Marine Corps MV-22B Osprey fleet. With this final delivery accomplished, the long-standing tiltrotor procurement program has now reached full completion, according to details published by AeroTime.

zh.title: 全日空向巴西航空工業增訂8架E190-E2
zh.summary: 全日空（ANA）於2026年7月29日宣布，將向巴西航空工業追加訂購8架E190-E2客機，擴大現有採購協議，相關消息由AeroTime率先報導。這項增訂將進一步強化全日空在區域航線的機隊彈性，並預計於未來數年內交付。分析師指出，新機型的燃油效率與維護成本優勢，將協助全日空優化營運成本結構。
body: 全日空（ANA）於2026年7月29日宣布，將向巴西航空工業追加訂購8架E190-E2客機，擴大現有採購協議。
消息由AeroTime率先報導，增訂將進一步強化全日空在區域航線的機隊彈性，並預計於未來數年內交付。
這項增訂反映航空公司對區域市場需求增長的預期，亦顯示巴西航空工業E2系列在亞太地區的市場接受度持續提升。
分析師指出，新機型的燃油效率與維護成本優勢，將協助全日空優化營運成本結構。

en.title: ANA adds eight new E190-E2 jets to Embraer order
en.summary: All Nippon Airways (ANA) announced on 29 July 2026 that it will add eight E190‑E2 aircraft to its existing order with Embraer, expanding the current procurement agreement. The increase was reported by AeroTime and is expected to bolster ANA’s regional fleet flexibility, with deliveries slated for the coming years. The additional jets will support growth on domestic and short‑haul international routes, complementing ANA’s existing fleet of larger narrow‑body aircraft. Industry analysts view the move as a strategic response to rising regional demand, noting the E2 series’ fuel‑efficiency and lower maintenance costs.

zh.title: LATAM航空展示旗下新款E195 E2機隊客艙內裝
zh.summary: LATAM航空於2026年7月28日公開其新款巴西航空工業E195 E2機隊的客艙內裝設計。此項展示呈現了該航空公司針對新引進機隊所規劃的內部配備，相關細節已由媒體報導。
body: LATAM航空於2026年7月28日正式對外公開其全新巴西航空工業E195 E2客機機隊的客艙內裝設計。這次發表展示了該航空公司針對旗下新引進機型所規劃的座艙配備與內部佈局細節。
根據AeroTime報導，LATAM航空公開新款E195 E2機隊的客艙設計，呈現了該航空公司對區域飛航客艙產品的最新規劃。該機隊的引進為航空公司整體營運佈局的一環。
本次客艙內裝的正式公布，確立了LATAM航空巴西航空工業E195 E2機隊的內部標準，相關機隊隨後將投入預定的航班營運服務。

en.title: LATAM Airlines Unveils Cabin Interiors for New Embraer E195 E2 Fleet
en.summary: On July 28, 2026, LATAM Airlines officially unveiled the cabin interiors for its new fleet of Embraer E195 E2 aircraft. The presentation highlights the interior layout and cabin features selected for the airline's upcoming regional jet operations. According to aviation news outlet AeroTime, the unveiling marks a milestone in LATAM Airlines' preparation to integrate the Embraer E195 E2 fleet into its operational network and service offerings for its passengers across its regional route system.
body: LATAM Airlines officially revealed the cabin interiors for its new Embraer E195 E2 aircraft fleet on July 28, 2026. The revelation provides a look into the seating and cabin amenities chosen for the airline's new regional aircraft.

As reported by AeroTime, the cabin interior design unveiling comes as LATAM Airlines prepares for the introduction of the Embraer E195 E2 aircraft to its fleet. The airline's new cabin features are intended for passenger service on upcoming routes.
The presentation establishes the interior cabin product specifications for the E195 E2 fleet as LATAM Airlines expands its operations.
